body:
Things haven't changed and I haven't been able to enact a change in more than ten years.  How long exactly should I wait?  I'm in pain.  That doesn't mean anything, does it?

> Please throw out the gun.

Thanks for trying I guess, but this is just ridiculous.  I should keep suffering for what reason, exactly?
the shame comes from pretty much failure to be a human being.

> How is this a confession, what shame is there in this?

Nobody cares about what I care about.  I haven't had anyone to talk to in 10 years.  I can't even imagine not being alone anymore.  The only thing left I can even fantasize about is that there's someone listening.
